takeaways: FinOps is a shared cultural practice between the people who build with technology and the people who pay for it, aimed at getting the most value rather than only cutting costs.
The practice runs on six principles and a repeating loop of inform, optimize and operate, with visibility through tagging and showback as the foundation.
Microsoft Cost Management, Azure Advisor, commitment discounts and the Microsoft 365 admin center give you the starting tools, but only ownership and habits keep the savings.
hook: Most companies discover they are overspending on cloud only when the invoice lands. This episode explains FinOps in plain language for beginners, IT pros and finance teams: its principles, its inform-optimize-operate loop and the tools already inside Microsoft 365 and Azure. You will learn how to start with one alert and one owner, and which mistakes to avoid.
